features.title: Make single-block Linear Search Teaching excellent
features.behavior: Linear Search Teaching should keep runtime state, visualization, generated code, highlighting, and explanation synchronized across run, step, reset, and level switches.

manual_checks: Run Linear Search Teaching with target found
Step Linear Search Teaching with target missing
Reset and confirm runtime state clears
Switch levels and confirm no stale explanation or highlight remains

features.title: Support Level 4 block-built Linear Search truthfully
features.behavior: Level 4 block-built Linear Search should either fully execute the supported block-built instruction path or clearly show which parts are partial without fake highlighting or fake explanations.

manual_checks: Build a valid Level 4 Linear Search block flow
Run and step the block-built flow
Confirm unsupported block combinations are stated as partial or unsupported
Confirm Puzzle and Sandbox navigation still works

features.title: Clarify Binary Search support and feedback
features.behavior: Binary Search should avoid fake Teaching support and, when implemented, explain the current comparison, decision, and remaining search interval without stale text from previous runs.

partial_support: Binary Search Exploration or existing runnable support
unsupported: Binary Search Teaching until explicitly implemented

manual_checks: Switch to another algorithm and confirm no stale binary-search explanation appears
